intro.en: Three whole home pages, each from a site you liked, each opening with your TUAN loading screen. Scroll all the way down on each. The loading screen plays every time here (on the real site it plays once per visit); click or press any key to skip it, R to see it again. On a page, , and . move between versions, 1 to 5 scores, N opens your notes, M marks a spot, B comes back here. Compare side by side plays them together.
intro.zh: 三個完整的首頁，各自來自一個你喜歡的網站，都用你的 TUAN 載入畫面開場。每一個都捲到最下面看看。這裡每次都會播載入畫面（正式網站每次來訪只播一次）；點一下或按任何鍵跳過，按 R 再看一次。在頁面上，逗號和句號鍵（, .）換版本，1 到 5 打分數，N 打開筆記，M 標記一個地方，B 回到這裡。「並排比較」可以一起播。

title.en: Second round: the rest of the page, under E's opening
title.zh: 第二輪：E 的開場之後，首頁其餘的部分

title.en: Third round: from Singita, Belmond and Jimmy Chin, which you marked Good
title.zh: 第三輪：從你標喜歡的 Singita、Belmond、Jimmy Chin 來做

title.en: Fourth round: bold makeovers of 12, with the Queensboro train
title.zh: 第四輪：大膽改造第 12 個，主角是皇后區那張列車

title.en: Fifth round: the live site's layering, taken further
title.zh: 第五輪：把正式網站的層疊捲動做得更多

title.en: The opening: colour while it is drawn
The opening: brushed onto the film

desc.en: From Martha King. Your Barcelona clips as one 12-second film with nothing written on it, coming into focus as the logo opens. Then the page is drawn over it: one sentence on its own screen, photographs at changing sizes like pages of a printed book, a second sentence, three doors in words.
desc.zh: 來自 Martha King。你的巴賽隆納影片剪成一段 12 秒的短片，上面不寫字，標誌打開時慢慢對焦。接著頁面從上面蓋過來：一句話佔一整個畫面，照片大小和位置變化，像一本印刷的書，第二句話，最後是三個用字做的入口。

desc.en: From Mathilde de Chiara. After the logo, twenty-one of your photographs fly in along the diagonal and settle in a row under it; Aoraki grows from the row into the whole window. Then one column down the middle of the paper, a sentence now and then.
desc.zh: 來自 Mathilde de Chiara。標誌出來之後，你的二十一張照片沿著斜線飛進來，在標誌下面排成一排；Aoraki 從那一排長大到整個畫面。接著是紙中間的一條直欄照片，偶爾一句話。

desc.en: From Belgrade Arbor. The logo's line runs to both edges and becomes a horizon; a pencil drawing of the road to the Sagrada Família spreads up and down from it, then turns into your film. Then whole blocks of olive and slate, one thought on each with photographs set into it, and paper between.
desc.zh: 來自 Belgrade Arbor。標誌的那條線延伸到兩邊變成地平線，聖家堂前面那條路的鉛筆素描從線往上下展開，再變成你的影片。接著是整塊橄欖綠和石板藍，每一塊一句話、照片嵌在裡面，中間是紙。

title.zh: 一筆一筆勾出來，再變成真的

desc.en: C as you asked: the logo's line runs to both edges, then the road to the Sagrada Família is traced line by line, starting at the towers and spreading out, as if drawn by hand; the pencil shading comes in under the lines, then it turns into your film. Now quicker: the logo holds a moment and the name fades slowly, the drawing takes about 2 seconds, then lines, shading and film dissolve as one; the film is up in about 9 seconds. A click skips it.
desc.zh: 照你說的改 C：標誌的線延伸到兩邊，接著聖家堂前那條路一筆一筆勾出來，從塔開始往外畫，像手在畫；畫完鉛筆的陰影慢慢出現在線條下面，再變成你的影片。現在比較快：標誌先停一下、名字慢慢淡掉，大約 2 秒畫完，線條、陰影和影片一口氣溶成一個畫面，9 秒左右進到影片，點一下可以跳過。

desc.en: D as you asked: while the road is drawn, the trip so far counts up along the foot of the drawing (21 countries, 41 flights, 93 photographs, read from the site's own data), then each scene of the film gets a small caption, the place and when, fading in and out with the scene.
desc.zh: 照你說的改 D：畫路的同時，畫面下方數出到目前為止的旅程（21 個國家、41 趟航班、93 張照片，直接從網站的資料算出來），接著影片的每一個場景都有一行小字幕，寫地方和時間，跟著場景淡入淡出。

title.en: Drawn, then real, all the way down

desc.en: E's opening, then the same move as the opening all the way down: each photograph first appears as its own pencil drawing and turns into the photograph once it is well in view. Five photographs at changing sizes, two quiet sentences, the three doors.
desc.zh: E 的開場之後，整頁都用開場同一招：每張照片先以鉛筆素描出現，捲到畫面中間時才變成真的照片。五張照片大小交錯，兩句安靜的話，最後三個入口。

desc.en: E's opening, then one photograph to a screen: as you scroll, each print slides up and lies on top of the last, like prints in a pile, each with its place and when beneath. The way in becomes three photographs, Gallery, Journey and Guides.
desc.zh: E 的開場之後，一個畫面一張照片：往下捲，每張照片滑上來蓋住上一張，像桌上一疊照片，下面寫地點和時間。最後的入口變成三張照片：作品集、旅程、攻略。

desc.en: E's opening, then four spreads of a printed travel journal: the photograph on one page, and on the other its place, when, and how it was made (camera, lens, aperture, shutter, ISO, read from the file), with a link to more from that country. The way in becomes a contents page with real counts.
desc.zh: E 的開場之後，像一本印出來的旅行手帳翻開四頁：一邊是照片，另一邊寫地點、時間和怎麼拍的（相機、鏡頭、光圈、快門、ISO，從照片檔案讀出來），再連到那個國家的更多照片。最後的入口變成目錄，附上真實的數字。

desc.en: After Singita. E's opening, then three big photographs, each with one short line beside it, never on it, the sides swapping. The way in is three tall photographs like windows (after Belmond): Gallery, Journey, Guides, each name beneath.
desc.zh: 從 Singita 來的。E 的開場之後，三張大照片，每張旁邊一句短短的話（不寫在照片上），左右交換。最後的入口是三張直的照片，像窗戶（從 Belmond 來的）：作品集、旅程、攻略，名字寫在下面。

desc.en: After Belmond. E's opening, then one row of six tall photographs across the whole width, one place each, the country and when beneath; each opens that country. Then the three words (after Jimmy Chin) under one photograph that fills the screen.
desc.zh: 從 Belmond 來的。E 的開場之後，一整排六張直的照片橫跨整個畫面，一張一個地方，下面寫國家和時間，點了就到那個國家。最後是三個大字（從 Jimmy Chin 來的），在一張撐滿畫面的照片下面。

desc.en: After Jimmy Chin. E's opening, two big photographs, then one that fills the screen with GALLERY, JOURNEY, GUIDES set huge and wide-spaced on the paper just beneath it, as the only way in. Nothing is written on the photograph.
desc.zh: 從 Jimmy Chin 來的。E 的開場之後，兩張大照片，然後一張撐滿畫面的照片，下面紙上只有三個很大、很開的字：作品集、旅程、攻略，這就是入口。照片上不寫字。

title.en: Your current home and the three words

desc.en: Your ask: the three words merged with your current home. E's opening, then your live home page's own sections exactly as they are now (the line and its two buttons, the aurora, the Photographs wall with its viewer, Fuji, the Guides cards), then its last photograph, the Matterhorn and the flag, fills the screen with GALLERY, JOURNEY, GUIDES beneath it, and your Instagram footer closes it. The sections are read from the live page each time it is built, so they stay current.
desc.zh: 照你說的：三個字和現在的首頁合在一起。E 的開場之後，接上現在正式首頁的內容，原封不動（那句話和兩個按鈕、極光、照片牆和點開的看圖、富士山、攻略卡片），最後那張馬特洪峰和國旗撐滿畫面，下面是作品集、旅程、攻略三個大字，再接你的 Instagram 頁尾。這些內容每次建置都從正式首頁讀進來，所以會跟著更新。

desc.en: Each place is a chapter on its own flat colour, its name set very large beside the photograph: New York in clay with the Queensboro train, Zermatt in slate, Sa Pa in olive, Mount Fuji on stone. Each photograph is uncovered upward as it arrives, like a print pulled from the tray. Then the three words under the aurora.
desc.zh: 每個地方是一章，各有一整片顏色，地名很大地放在照片旁邊：紐約配陶土色和皇后區列車、策馬特配石板藍、沙壩配橄欖綠、富士山配石頭色。照片出現時由下往上露出來，像從顯影盤拿起一張相片。最後是極光下的三個大字。

desc.en: One photograph to a screen like a magazine cover, its name set huge and split around it: Queensboro | Plaza, Mount | Fuji, Roys | Peak, Lake | Tekapo. The two halves slide in toward the photograph as it arrives. Then the three words under the Matterhorn.
desc.zh: 一個畫面一張照片，像雜誌封面，名字很大地拆在照片兩邊：Queensboro | Plaza、Mount | Fuji、Roys | Peak、Lake | Tekapo，捲到時兩半往照片靠過來。最後是馬特洪峰下的三個大字。

desc.en: Like a photographer's light table: one big print held on the left, your picks laid out beside it. Point at or tap any of them and it becomes the big print. The Queensboro train is on the table first. Then the three words under Roys Peak.
desc.zh: 像攝影師的看片桌：左邊一張大照片，右邊排著你的精選。滑過或點任何一張，它就變成大的那張。皇后區列車先放在桌上。最後是羅伊峰下的三個大字。

desc.en: Half the screen holds the photograph, the other half reads place by place: the place, its name, one line about what is in the photograph, when, and a link. As each place reaches the middle, its photograph takes over the held half. Queensboro Plaza first, then Zermatt at dusk, Sa Pa, Tekapo, the Calanque. Then the three words under Fuji.
desc.zh: 畫面一半放照片，另一半一個地方一個地方讀下去：地點、名稱、一句照片裡有什麼、時間、連結。每個地方捲到中間時，它的照片就換上那一半。先是皇后區廣場站，接著暮色的策馬特、沙壩、蒂卡波、昂沃峽灣。最後是富士山下的三個大字。

desc.en: Straight after the film, the way in: three tall windows with the three words large beneath them, the Milky Way for Gallery, the Queensboro train for Journey, the Sagrada Família for Guides. Then your picks at changing sizes, and one last line.
desc.zh: 影片一結束就是入口：三扇直的窗，下面是三個大字，銀河是作品集，皇后區列車是旅程，聖家堂是攻略。接著是你的精選照片大小交錯，最後一句話。

desc.en: The live site's windows (a hole cut in the page, the photograph fixed behind it, drifting slowly as you pass) in more shapes: the Queensboro train fills a whole screen, the Milky Way shows through a tall hole framed by paper, Mount Fuji through two holes side by side onto one photograph, rows of your picks between. The three words sit under Roys Peak, itself a window.
desc.zh: 正式網站的「窗」（頁面上挖一個洞，照片固定在後面，捲動時慢慢飄）做成更多形狀：皇后區列車撐滿一整個畫面，銀河從一個被紙框住的直窗看出去，富士山從並排的兩個洞看到同一張照片，中間是你的精選照片。三個大字在羅伊峰下面，那張也是一扇窗。

desc.en: One photograph holds the whole screen while your prints float up over it, some faster than others: first the Queensboro train behind Matterhorn, Sa Pa, Fuji and the church at Tekapo; then the aurora behind Roys Peak, the Calanque, the Golden Gate and the Milky Way. Then the three words under the Matterhorn.
desc.zh: 一張照片撐住整個畫面，你的照片一張張從上面飄過，有快有慢：先是皇后區列車在後面，飄過馬特洪峰、沙壩、富士山、蒂卡波的教堂；再換極光在後面，飄過羅伊峰、昂沃峽灣、金門大橋、銀河。最後是馬特洪峰下的三個大字。

desc.en: Version 12 with more layers: your live line and buttons, then the Queensboro train as a full window, the photo wall with your picks, Mount Fuji with the bullet train through two holes, your Guides cards, the Tekapo church through a framed hole, and the three words under the Matterhorn and the flag, now a window too. Your Instagram footer closes it.
desc.zh: 第 12 個多加幾層：正式首頁那句話和按鈕，接著皇后區列車一整扇窗，照片牆換成你的精選，富士山和新幹線從兩個洞看，攻略卡片，蒂卡波的教堂從一個被紙框住的洞看，最後是馬特洪峰和國旗下的三個大字，那張現在也是一扇窗，再接 Instagram 頁尾。

desc.en: E as you asked: no grey pencil stage. While the road is drawn, the colour of the film's first frame washes in under the lines, starting at the towers and spreading out the way the pencil goes, pale at first and deepening. As the last lines land the colour is all there and the film starts moving; the lines and counts lift off it. The film is up about 2 seconds sooner than E. Only the opening changed; the rest of the page is E's.
desc.zh: 照你說的改 E：拿掉灰色的鉛筆階段。畫路的同時，影片第一格的顏色在線條下面慢慢浮出來，從塔開始往外擴，跟鉛筆走的方向一樣，先淡淡的再越來越濃。最後幾筆畫完時顏色已經到位，影片直接開始動，線條和數字再淡掉。比 E 大約早 2 秒進到影片。只改了開場，下面的部分和 E 一樣。

desc.en: The lines themselves are drawn in colour, with no grey pencil at all: each line is the colour of what it outlines. Then each is gone over again, wider and wider, until the colour fills out from the lines; long strokes colour the sky last. Same timing as E: the colour is all there as the last lines land, then the film starts moving. A click skips it.
desc.zh: 線條本身就是彩色的，完全沒有灰色鉛筆：每一筆都是它畫的東西的顏色。接著每條線再被描過幾次，越描越粗，顏色從線條裡長出來填滿；天空最後用長長的筆觸塗上。時間和 E 一樣：最後幾筆畫完時顏色已經到位，影片接著開始動。點一下可以跳過。

desc.en: Grey lines as in E, and close behind them coloured pencil hatching: fine diagonal strokes, then a second layer crossing them, put down wherever the pencil has just been. The hatching texture shows until the film starts. Same timing as E: the colour is all there as the last lines land, then the film starts moving. A click skips it.
desc.zh: 線條和 E 一樣是灰色的，緊跟在後面的是色鉛筆排線：細細的斜線，再一層交叉的斜線，鉛筆剛畫到哪裡就排到哪裡。影片開始前看得到排線的紋理。時間和 E 一樣：最後幾筆畫完時顏色已經到位，影片接著開始動。點一下可以跳過。

desc.en: Grey lines, and each line carries a soft band of colour with it, as if the colour were rubbed in with a finger right after the line; the sky is filled with broad soft strokes. The gentlest of the five. Same timing as E: the colour is all there as the last lines land, then the film starts moving. A click skips it.
desc.zh: 灰色線條，每一筆都帶著一圈柔和的顏色，像畫完一筆馬上用手指把顏色抹開；天空用寬寬軟軟的筆觸補上。五個裡面最柔和的。時間和 E 一樣：最後幾筆畫完時顏色已經到位，影片接著開始動。點一下可以跳過。

desc.en: Grey lines, and the colour catches in the paper's tooth like a coloured pencil on rough paper: first a scatter of coloured specks, then denser, then solid, in three passes behind the lines. Same timing as E: the colour is all there as the last lines land, then the film starts moving. A click skips it.
desc.zh: 灰色線條，顏色像色鉛筆畫在粗紙上，卡在紙的紋路裡：先是一點一點的色點，越來越密，最後塗滿，跟在線條後面分三次上色。時間和 E 一樣：最後幾筆畫完時顏色已經到位，影片接著開始動。點一下可以跳過。

desc.en: Grey lines, and quick zigzag scribbles of colour fill each patch the pencil has just reached, like colouring in fast by hand; a second round of scribbles crosses the first. Same timing as E: the colour is all there as the last lines land, then the film starts moving. A click skips it.
desc.zh: 灰色線條，鉛筆剛畫到的地方馬上用快速的來回塗鴉上色，像用手很快地塗顏色；第二輪塗鴉再交叉塗過去。時間和 E 一樣：最後幾筆畫完時顏色已經到位，影片接著開始動。點一下可以跳過。

desc.en: A wide brush sweeps left to right, row under row, top to bottom, on a slight slant, the strokes full of paint in the middle with dry, streaky edges and tails. Your logo first, as before; no pencil and no still picture: the film is already playing under the white, so every stroke uncovers moving footage, and once the last row is down the page is simply the film. The counts sit on the white strip at the foot and step aside before the brush gets there. A click skips it.
desc.zh: 一支寬刷子由左往右刷，一排接一排從上往下，稍微斜一點；筆觸中間顏料飽滿，邊緣和尾巴乾乾的、有刷痕。先是你的標誌，和之前一樣；沒有鉛筆、也沒有靜止的畫面：白色底下影片已經在播，每一刷刷開的都是會動的畫面，最後一排刷完，畫面就是影片。數字在底部的白色上，刷子到之前先讓開。點一下可以跳過。

desc.en: A narrower brush and more rows, quicker strokes, a little more slant: more like painting a wall stroke by stroke. Your logo first, as before; no pencil and no still picture: the film is already playing under the white, so every stroke uncovers moving footage, and once the last row is down the page is simply the film. The counts sit on the white strip at the foot and step aside before the brush gets there. A click skips it.
desc.zh: 比較窄的刷子、比較多排、每一刷更快、也更斜一點：比較像一筆一筆刷牆。先是你的標誌，和之前一樣；沒有鉛筆、也沒有靜止的畫面：白色底下影片已經在播，每一刷刷開的都是會動的畫面，最後一排刷完，畫面就是影片。數字在底部的白色上，刷子到之前先讓開。點一下可以跳過。

desc.en: The same wide brush on a steep slant, so the picture opens corner to corner, the bottom right last. Your logo first, as before; no pencil and no still picture: the film is already playing under the white, so every stroke uncovers moving footage, and once the last row is down the page is simply the film. The counts sit on the white strip at the foot and step aside before the brush gets there. A click skips it.
desc.zh: 同一支寬刷子，但斜得很明顯，畫面從一個角往對角打開，右下角最後刷開。先是你的標誌，和之前一樣；沒有鉛筆、也沒有靜止的畫面：白色底下影片已經在播，每一刷刷開的都是會動的畫面，最後一排刷完，畫面就是影片。數字在底部的白色上，刷子到之前先讓開。點一下可以跳過。

desc.en: A wide brush, painted briskly, band after band from the top, one long stroke or two where the first runs dry. As a hand paints: one stroke at a time with a lift between, each a different length, angle and speed, arcing the way an arm does; the paint full where the brush lands and breaking into dry streaks as it runs out; then a few quick touches where the paper still shows. The film plays slowly under the brush and comes back to its own pace, so the first shot stays on a moment after the last stroke. The counts step aside before the brush reaches them. A click skips it.
desc.zh: 一支寬刷子，刷得俐落，從上面一排一排往下，一筆刷到底，或是第一筆乾了再接一筆。像手在刷：一次一筆，中間會提起來，每一筆長短、角度、速度都不一樣，跟手臂一樣有弧度；刷子落下的地方顏料飽滿，越刷越乾，變成乾乾的刷痕；最後在還看得到白紙的地方補幾筆。刷的時候影片在底下慢慢播，刷完再回到正常速度，所以最後一筆之後第一個畫面還會停留一下。刷子到之前數字先讓開。點一下可以跳過。

desc.en: More paint on a wider brush, slower and fuller strokes, fewer dry streaks. As a hand paints: one stroke at a time with a lift between, each a different length, angle and speed, arcing the way an arm does; the paint full where the brush lands and breaking into dry streaks as it runs out; then a few quick touches where the paper still shows. The film plays slowly under the brush and comes back to its own pace, so the first shot stays on a moment after the last stroke. The counts step aside before the brush reaches them. A click skips it.
desc.zh: 更寬、沾更多顏料的刷子，筆觸比較慢、比較飽滿，乾刷痕比較少。像手在刷：一次一筆，中間會提起來，每一筆長短、角度、速度都不一樣，跟手臂一樣有弧度；刷子落下的地方顏料飽滿，越刷越乾，變成乾乾的刷痕；最後在還看得到白紙的地方補幾筆。刷的時候影片在底下慢慢播，刷完再回到正常速度，所以最後一筆之後第一個畫面還會停留一下。刷子到之前數字先讓開。點一下可以跳過。

desc.en: Little paint, fast and loose: strokes at freer angles, more dry streaks (飛白) and flecks flung off the ends. As a hand paints: one stroke at a time with a lift between, each a different length, angle and speed, arcing the way an arm does; the paint full where the brush lands and breaking into dry streaks as it runs out; then a few quick touches where the paper still shows. The film plays slowly under the brush and comes back to its own pace, so the first shot stays on a moment after the last stroke. The counts step aside before the brush reaches them. A click skips it.
desc.zh: 顏料少、刷得快又鬆：角度比較隨意，乾刷的飛白比較多，筆尾還會甩出一點點顏料。像手在刷：一次一筆，中間會提起來，每一筆長短、角度、速度都不一樣，跟手臂一樣有弧度；刷子落下的地方顏料飽滿，越刷越乾，變成乾乾的刷痕；最後在還看得到白紙的地方補幾筆。刷的時候影片在底下慢慢播，刷完再回到正常速度，所以最後一筆之後第一個畫面還會停留一下。刷子到之前數字先讓開。點一下可以跳過。

question.en: Three hands brushing the film in. Give each a score.
question.zh: 三種像人手在刷的方式，每個打個分數。
